newsitem.title: FRANCE: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST - AUG 13.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Media & the Internet and Brand-name Products.
PARIS - The audience share of French private television station TF1 slumped in July compared to June, measurement institute Mediametrie reports. (Reuter)
PARIS - French advertising group Publicis says its first half sales rose 16 percent to 12.38 million francs ($2 million), taking into account disposals to True North as well as acquisitons. (Reuter)

LONDON - Easynet Group, Britain's fast-growing Internet service provider (ISP), says it will wait until it has built up its UK and French presence before considering buying its way into new markets. (Reuters)
PARIS - A growing number of French companies are opening Internet sites, and the question of whether to take the plunge onto the Web is being discussed by
PARIS - The arrival of the Pope in France next week for World Youth Days has prompted a plethora of sponsoring by firms hoping to boost their image. (Le Figaro, La Tribune)

PARIS - Advertisers of baby products overwhelmingly pick television to promote nappies, formula and baby food. Insitute Audipub found 78 percent of their adverts were carried on television last year. It also found that household spending on the first two children is constantly growing. (La Tribune)

PARIS - LVMH Moet Hennesey Louis Vuitton says its turnover rose to 21.59 billion francs in the first half of 1997 from 13.37 billion in the six months to June 30, 1996. Its parent, Christian Dior, had first half sales 59 percent higher at 22.18 billion francs from 13.95 billion in the year earlier period.(Reuter)
PARIS - European new car registrations rose 9.1 percent in July, making a rise of 2.7 percent in new car sales in Europe since the beginning of this year. (Les Echos)
